theorems.name: Submission.tgc_cone_density_graph_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (P : Grassmannian N n) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, (∀ v : Euclidean N, ‖Grassmannian.project T v - Grassmannian.project P v‖ ≤ L / 4 * ‖v‖) ∧ (∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall x t)) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μ {y | y ∈ closedBall x t ∧ L / 16 * ‖y - x‖ ≤ ‖(y - x) - Grassmannian.project T (y - x)‖} ≤ ε * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n) → ∃ Γ : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ i, IsClosed (Γ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ Γ i, ∀ z ∈ Γ i, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, ∃ i, x ∈ Γ i
